headline: KEC International secures transmission line contracts from Power Grid
hook: New transmission orders for KEC International
summary: KEC International has been awarded new orders for transmission line projects by Power Grid Corporation of India. This win reinforces the company's position in the domestic power transmission space.

headline: KEC International secures Rs 1,006 crore in fresh orders despite stock hitting 52-week low
hook: New orders arrive as shares slide
summary: RPG Group company KEC International has bagged new orders worth Rs 1,006 crore across transmission, tower supply, and hospital construction segments. This latest win brings the company's total year-to-date order intake to Rs 10,600 crore. However, the stock price continues to face downward pressure, hitting a new 52-week low despite the continuous order inflows. For Indian retail investors, this highlights a disconnect between strong order book execution and market sentiment for engineering and construction firms.

winners_losers: KEC International holders hurt by falling stock

headline: Ten Nifty 500 stocks plunge up to 58% over the past year
hook: Heavy wealth erosion in past one year
summary: Ten Nifty 500 stocks have dropped between 47% and 58% over the past year, heavily underperforming the broader market. KEC International, Reliance Power, and KPIT Technologies lead this list of laggards. Nearly 50 stocks within the index have recorded declines exceeding 30% during the same timeframe. Indian retail investors holding underperforming mid and small-cap stocks face ongoing portfolio drag from these sharp corrections.
why_it_matters: Portfolio returns lag if you hold severe index laggards

headline: Kotak Institutional Equities upgrades KEC International to 'Add'
hook: Brokerage turns bullish on KEC International
summary: Kotak Institutional Equities has upgraded KEC International to an 'Add' rating. The brokerage cites growing momentum in the company's cables and wires segment as a key driver. This upgrade comes despite the stock experiencing a 60% decline over the past year.
why_it_matters: Brokerage backing may signal a potential turnaround for the stock.
